{{Quote|I fled into the tangled stars beyond Kitel Phard, following secret ways Xendor had discovered. But the Green Blade followed, and I was cornered on Irkalla.|Arden Lyn|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Irkalla''' was an astronomical object beyond the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atrisia/Legends|Kitel Phard]] where, at the end of the [[First Great Schism]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]] and [[Legions of Lettow]] leader [[Arden Lyn]] [[Duel on Irkalla|faced off]]. Pina suffered a mortal wound, but before dying, used [[Morichro/Legends|morichro]] to stop Lyn's heart. At some point, an unidentified party discovered Lyn's body, and constructed a [[Arden Lyn's tomb|tomb]], in which it was suspended in a stasis field, only to reawaken some [[4 BBY/Legends|24,496 years]] later during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />
